notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (ffmpeg/libsndfile/browsers); Demucs ran on that decode. The tempo is NOT constant: it drifts from ~124.9 BPM in the intro to ~127.6 by the last chorus (a Suno generation), so beats come from beats.py (librosa DP tracking at a 2.9 ms hop on drums+mix onsets, intervals smoothed over +-6 beats, phase re-anchored to the tracked beats in windows); bpm here is the median. Bar phase: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on beat indices 1 and 3 mod 4, off-beat 8th hats; the half-bar ambiguity is resolved by the harmony, which changes chord on every beat index = 0 mod 4. First downbeat 0.158 s; downbeats = beats[0::4]. Sections start on downbeats (SECTION_BARS in analyze.py). Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack of the <120 Hz band (362); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks with a loud 0.5-5 kHz noise tail (180); hat = >7 kHz attacks away from snares and kicks (781). vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone), including backing vocals.
